mary_infant_shadow.prompt: a young veiled mother clutching a swaddled infant to her chest, a long thin cold shadow falling diagonally across her robe, dark temple stone behind, vertical, ancient Judea

mary_at_cross.prompt: a veiled grieving woman seen from behind her shoulder, looking up at a tall simple wooden cross of two rough beams where the crucified Christ hangs high above the ground, his whole body lifted well above her, clear morning light, low angle, vertical, 1st-century Judea

jesus_looks_down.prompt: the thorn-crowned crucified Christ seen from below from the chest up, his head turned downward with steady compassion toward those beneath the cross, clear morning light on his face, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

mary_and_john.prompt: a young bearded disciple wrapping his arm around a veiled grieving woman's shoulders, both looking up at the crucified Christ hanging on the cross rising beside them, clear morning light, vertical, 1st-century Judea

john_leads_home.prompt: a young dark-haired bearded disciple gently leading a veiled older woman along a dusty road toward the gate of a walled town, far behind them three small crosses on a low rise, warm late afternoon light, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

face_on_cross.prompt: a close portrait of the crucified Christ from the shoulders up, his thorn-crowned head lifted, eyes open toward heaven, the rough wooden beam behind his head, dim failing light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

golgotha_hill_wide.prompt: a wide view of three crosses standing on the low rocky rise of Golgotha outside the walls of Jerusalem, the crosses short rough wooden posts, the crucified men stripped to plain loincloths with their feet hanging just above the bystanders' heads, the centre cross bearing the crucified Christ, his bare dark hair against the open sky and his bare feet resting together against the wood, a crucified thief stripped to a loincloth on each cross beside him, small mourners standing close below, low stone houses with plain bare flat earthen roofs beyond the wall, the skyline beyond only plain rooftops under open sky, clear morning light under a plain pale sky, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

us_under_cross_shadow.prompt: two bowed figures kneeling small in the dust at dawn, the long shadow of a single cross falling across them and stretching up the ground, heads down and hands clasped, soft low golden light, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea
